catalog.definition: Daily Indonesian stock OHLCV candles sourced from TradingView.
catalog.grain: One row per ticker and trading date
catalog.update_rule: DAILY and RECOVERY price runs upsert exact-date candles; committed inserts/updates with non-null ingestion_time transactionally enqueue Feature 01 work.
catalog.availability_rule: Use the close-of-day observation no earlier than the next valid trading observation t+1. Historical ingestion_time can be NULL and does not prove same-day availability.
catalog.historical_metadata_method: Historical OHLCV is retained, but current-universe construction and incomplete historical ingestion timestamps require survivorship and availability disclosure.

catalog.definition: Daily per-ticker price, return, volatility, volume, and drawdown features.
catalog.grain: One row per ticker and trading date
catalog.update_rule: Explicit refresh routine after validated source changes; automatic price-cron integration is not active.
catalog.availability_rule: Signal uses information through close t; earliest permitted simulated entry is the next valid trading observation t+1.
catalog.historical_metadata_method: Price features are historical, but sector/industry are current classifications and the table may omit securities absent from the current IDX_Stock_Universe.

column_catalog.definition: Trading date represented by the price row.
Trading volume reported by the source.
Date the source data was queried.
Timezone-aware database statement time of the latest successful insert or upsert; null for historical rows whose exact ingestion time is unknown.
